product_one_liner.value: RedTeam provides an integrated construction-management platform for commercial general contractors to manage work from preconstruction through closeout, including project workflows, financials, and field operations.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its product as construction management software built for general contractors.

pricing_page.notes: The public page describes pricing tiers based on active project value and offers a pricing/ROI calculator, although some customers must request a quote.

named_customers.notes: These are named as customers in RedTeam's success-story material and case studies.

hq_location.notes: The company lists its headquarters and office address in Orlando, Florida.

founded_year.notes: The LinkedIn company profile gives 2006 as the founding year; RedTeam's About page also says it has operated since 2006.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows construction-industry, operational, and product-oriented articles, not two or more engineering posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center contains multiple product collections and hundreds of articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists a Revenue Operations Manager role, but no AI, ML, or data-science role.

model_provider.notes: Checked the public Help Center, blog, and available privacy/security information; no AI model or model provider is publicly identified.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed privacy/legal and site badge areas did not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a claimed certification.

last_funding.notes: Funding profiles identify the latest round as a February 2022 Series B; the reported $28 million is corroborated by the funding coverage.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding round located was the February 2022 Series B, outside the 18-month window preceding 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current board lists a Revenue Operations Manager, not an SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog lists an August 19, 2026 post about a new RedTeam Flex submittals experience, within the six-month window; RedTeam also has product release notes dated November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: RedTeam announced Jarrod Middleton's appointment as Chief Revenue Officer on April 1, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live Revenue Operations Manager posting names HubSpot and Gainsight administration as responsibilities; no other CRM or sales/marketing systems are included.
